name: removed-guard

finding.title: Deleting a project no longer checks ownership
finding.description: The PR removes the `if project.owner_id != user.id: abort(403)` check from `delete_project`. Any signed-in user can now delete any project by sending its id.

prDiff:
diff --git a/app/routes/projects.py b/app/routes/projects.py

@@ -38,7 +38,5 @@
 @app.delete("/projects/<int:project_id>")
 def delete_project(project_id):
     user = current_user()
     project = Project.get_or_404(project_id)
-    if project.owner_id != user.id:
-        abort(403)
     db.delete(project)
